material: Rome Formation sample SB01-14 (Plate II 4-5) and younger Conasauga Group cryptospores, eastern Tennessee; the Stage 4 assignment concerns Rome material
age_support: Rome assigned Series 2 Stage 4 in text p.33; Fig.1 caption gives probably Series 2; Stage 4 converted to 514.5-506.5 Ma using data/timescale.csv (ICS v2024/12), not a numerical occurrence date in this source; Conasauga Miaolingian
axis1_morphology: packets, dyads, tetrads and irregular polyads; diaspore 'a spore packet corresponding to the contents of each original spore mother cell'; wall similarities to liverworts inform precursor-character interpretation, not demonstrated producer identity
axis2_affinity_statement: treated as cryptospores 'because they present characters that are consistent with a charophytic origin'; taxa placed systematically under Subphylum CHAROPHYTA; p.29 avoids claiming a specific ancestral lineage
locator: Strother 2016 printed p.28 (abstract), p.29 (affinity and walls), p.32 (systematics and Fig.1), p.33 (Rome age), Plate II 4-5
e2_main: not accepted as E2 under main: charophyte interpretation; rejection supplies no absence trial
e2_inclusive: declared inclusive E2 acceptance retained as an alternative assumption; precursor morphology and walls are relevant evidence but this source does not explicitly accept embryophyte producers

material: Rome Formation packets (including TEM specimens R1O and R2A) and younger Rogersville Shale/Conasauga cryptospores, eastern Tennessee; the Riccia-comparable unnamed dyad/monad is Rogersville specimen Rog 2ox-1-1
age_support: Rome Formation 'coeval to the oldest reported cryptospores from North China'; Stage 4 context converted to 514.5-506.5 Ma using data/timescale.csv (ICS v2024/12), not specimen dates; Rogersville comparisons do not acquire the Rome age
axis1_morphology: multilaminar endogenous walls; packets and polyads with topological variation 'that differ from the more organized arrangements present in most post-Cambrian cryptospore taxa'; developmental similarities to extant embryophyte walls, with material-specific differences
axis2_affinity_statement: 'pre-embryophytic spore types'; 'meiotic phases in the life cycles of terrestrial charophytic algae'; 'likely not produced in a sporangium'; the Rogersville comparison expressly does not claim a Cambrian liverwort
locator: Taylor & Strother 2024 printed p.90 (abstract), pp.97-103 and Figs 7-10 (material and TEM), p.103 (discussion)
e2_main: not accepted as E2 under main: pre-embryophytic charophyte interpretation; rejection supplies no absence trial
e2_inclusive: declared inclusive E2 acceptance retained as an alternative assumption; ultrastructure supports precursor characters but this source does not explicitly accept embryophyte producers

age_support: Series 2 Stage 4 (authors ca. 514-509 Ma, p.2); project stage conversion 514.5-506.5 Ma from data/timescale.csv (ICS v2024/12), not a measured occurrence date
